content.rendered:
At Sherwood School District, we are committed to providing an engaging and inclusive educational experience for all students. Section 504 of the Rehabilitation Act is a federal law that protects the rights of students with disabilities, ensuring they receive the accommodations and support they need to fully access the general education curriculum. Through individualized 504 Plans, we work closely with families and educators to create learning environments where every student can succeed. Please contact your school counselor for more information regarding Section 504 or if you suspect that you child has a disability. You may also call the Sherwood School District Student Services Department at (503)825-5031.
